claim: A frame-locked game can read 0.00% pace whatever the update costs inside; also compare cycles from the wait's end to the update's end, and check frames per update before concluding there is no frame sync.

evidence.text: A game that waits on N interrupts per update makes pace read 0.00% whatever the update costs inside; compare cycles from the wait's end to the update's end too.
evidence.quote: A game that waits on N interrupts per update makes pace read 0.00% whatever the update costs inside

evidence.text: Frame-locked pace hid a slower figure phase: updates equal, but the beeper plays only while waiting for the interrupt, so port FE writes fell 8 % in busy scenes; the limiter and the prepared patterns brought them back (510.4 / 509.6 a second).
evidence.quote: the beeper plays only while waiting for the interrupt, so port FE writes fell 8 % in busy scenes.
